items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Bill Bailey was the dancer with the show and he’s Pearl Bailey’s brother, who I had worked with at the Southland in Boston

ctx.x: Did you find Billie Holiday different or a little difficult to play with because she often times would sing pretty far behind the beat?

Yeah. No I didn’t find that to be true at all. As a matter of fact she showed up at Bernie Hanighen’s in a house coat with some egg stains on it, and not put together at all, and the minute she started to sing she looked very beautiful. It happens all the time of course. Like for example, when I was over in London, I was with Ernie Anderson getting a theater together and so forth, and a guy named Jerome White, Jerry White, he worked for the Rodgers and Hammerstein people, and he was a master sergeant like myself,…
Right. Well you did some singing yourself over the years.
